pub.description: EasyRadio is a customizable radio button widget for Flutter that offers consistent animation, easy customization of sizes, shape, inner dot shape.

gh.description: EasyRadio is a customizable Flutter widget for creating sleek and animated radio buttons. It offers options for dot size, border colors, and animation effects. With support for circular or custom shapes, and the ability to toggle, it provides a user-friendly interface for selecting a single option from a group.
